# PatientGamers — Zehnpae’s retrospective

- Original source: [The Good, The Bad, The Questionable](https://www.reddit.com/r/patientgamers/comments/1ua0o78/robin_hood_the_legend_of_sherwood_the_good_the/)
- Author / publication: Zehnpae; Reddit r/patientgamers.
- Language / date: English; exact date not exposed, displayed age two months.
- Access: Complete opening review and displayed discussion inspected.
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Format: original summary and research notes; not a transcript.

Zehnpae praises the colorful backgrounds and forgiving interpretation of combat gestures but criticizes movement, pathfinding, and attempts to knock out guards turning into unwanted sword fights. The writer reports abandoning careful nonlethal play after a mission counted deaths they did not cause, then finding the remaining campaign less tedious.

This adds a separate account to the existing spared-life statistics discussion, without identifying the mission or establishing the cause. Replies discuss repeated environments and alternative nonlethal tactics. A compatibility patch is mentioned without an exact download link or configuration, so the review is not a reproducible installation guide.
